meta.description: Universal booking link: ?email= (or ?cid=) goes to the contact owner's meeting link, anyone else to the next rep in the rotation with a link. Logs each visit. Reads HubSpot only.

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'settings', (SELECT row_to_json(s) FROM cypress_rr_settings s WHERE s.id = 1),
  'reps', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(r ORDER BY r.position, r.id) FROM cypress_rr_reps r), '[]'::json),
  'recent', (
    SELECT row_to_json(b) FROM cypress_rr_bookings b
    WHERE p.j->>'email' <> '' AND b.email = p.j->>'email' AND b.rep_id IS NOT NULL AND b.created_at > now() - interval '1 day'
    ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
  )
) AS body
FROM p;

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO cypress_rr_bookings (email, contact_id, contact_name, owner_id, rep_id, rep_name, url, route, reason, skipped)
  SELECT COALESCE(j->>'email', ''), j->>'contact_id', COALESCE(j->>'contact_name', ''), j->>'owner_id',
    NULLIF(j->>'rep_id', '')::int, COALESCE(j->>'rep_name', ''), COALESCE(j->>'url', ''), j->>'route',
    COALESCE(j->>'reason', ''), COALESCE(j->'skipped', '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM p
  RETURNING id
),
ptr AS (
  UPDATE cypress_rr_settings s SET last_rep_id = (p.j->>'rep_id')::int, last_position = (p.j->>'rep_position')::int
  FROM p WHERE s.id = 1 AND p.j->>'route' = 'rotation'
  RETURNING s.id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS saved;
